newsitem.title: FRANCE: French music radios show audience changes - study.
newsitem.headline: French music radios show audience changes - study.

text.p: French general radio stations Europe 1 and RMC showed small rises in market share in the first quarter of 1997 in a market that is stable overall, but the biggest changes came among music stations, according to a study published on Tuesday by French media watcher Mediametrie.
Market share rose at music stations NRJ, RFM, RTL2 and Skyrock, fell at Cherie FM, Europe 2 and Nostalgie and was stable at Fun Radio in the period, the survey showed.
The study, called Enquete 75000 Mediametrie, compares audience figures for January to March 1997 with figures for November and December of 1996.
It is carried out four times a year, for the first and second quarters, then for the two-month periods of September-October and November-December.

Besides market share, the study measures the number of people who tune in to a particular station at least once a day, as a percentage in which one percent represents 467,630 people aged 15 and over, and the average length of listening time per listener, in minutes.
Europe 1 scored strongly on listening time but saw a sharp fall in its audience, while among music stations there was more coherence overall between the results of the three measures.
Listening time fell sharply at Cherie FM, Europe 2 and Fun Radio, while NRJ showed a strong rise in audience but a slight fall in listening time.
A=Audience (one percent=467,630), MS=market share (percent) L=Listening time (minutes)
